alexcrichton opened PR #15126 from alexcrichton:reduce-x64-macos-testing to bytecodealliance:main:

macOS is one of our more limited resources in CI having a pretty limited amount of parallelism, and the x86_64 target isn't really worth the 8 CI jobs it now takes. Reduce this to just testing *.wast tests to ensure at least something works, and otherwise try to free up macOS capacity.
